author: Wetzer & Bruce, 1999

note.en: A tiny sphaeromatid isopod described from Costa Rica, with a 1986 specimen from 4.5 m at Punta Vargas in Cahuita National Park; too small to notice in the water.
note.es: Un isópodo esferomátido diminuto descrito de Costa Rica, con un ejemplar de 1986 tomado a 4,5 m en Punta Vargas, Parque Nacional Cahuita; demasiado pequeño para notarlo en el agua.

evidence: GBIF: USNM specimen (1986), 4.5 m, Punta Vargas, Cahuita National Park
SeaLifeBase lists Costa Rica as its only territory

sources.t: GBIF occurrence records, Caribbean Costa Rica and Bocas del Toro
